title: Bought ranch as skeptic intending to donate to Boy Scouts
summary: Breaks Silence tells of Bought ranch as skeptic intending to donate to Boy Scouts, about 2016 at Skinwalker Ranch, Utah, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: claims and I actually intended to to donate it to the Boy Scouts of America

plain: The owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah that his interview ties to UFOs, spoke to a podcast host, Jesse Michels. He says that when he bought the ranch around 2016 he did not believe the strange claims about it, and that he actually meant to give it away to the Boy Scouts of America. He mentions the names Robert Bigelow and Chris Lee as he tells it, and he tells it to show he started out a doubter, not a believer.
